concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: mobile app icon concept for an existing Korean vocabulary study app named 리보카 (re:voca), aimed at high-school students, with short daily study sessions and spaced review. Design a polished, confident, contemporary and friendly educational brand, calm and focused, not childish. Output ONE square icon, full-bleed opaque background extending all the way to all four square edges. This is the raw icon art, NOT an icon drawn on a presentation board. Do not pre-round the outer canvas corners. Center the main symbol inside the middle 66% of the square with generous balanced margin, making it legible at a tiny launcher size. Crisp flat vector-like graphic, carefully balanced optical proportions. No mockup, phone, captions, watermark, external frame, 3D, shadows, grain, gradients, extra decorations or other apps' logos. Concept 1 — typographic brand signature. Use a solid fresh lime #C8F476 background. In the center place the exact text "re:" in very bold custom geometric lowercase sans-serif lettering with gently rounded terminals, tightly and expertly kerned, width about 65% of canvas. The lowercase r and e are deep charcoal #20251F. The colon consists of two substantial vertically aligned circular dots in warm dark terracotta #8D3E24, sized to remain visible when tiny. Give the e a generous clear counter. Restrained, memorable, editorial-quality typography. The only text is exactly "re:". Do not include the full name, additional letters, symbols, book, arrow, or tagline.
